title: Coordinate preservation under sign-cube combination
statement: Let the free coordinates in a sign cube of dimension $4$ be $\{0,1\}$, and fix the signs on the other coordinates by assigning $+1$ at coordinate $2$ and $-1$ at coordinate $3$. For every assignment $y$ of signs to the free coordinates, combining $y$ with these fixed signs gives a sign vector whose coordinate $0$ is $y(0)$.
hypotheses_covered: The free-coordinate set is {0,1} in dimension 4
The fixed assignment is +1 at coordinate 2 and -1 at coordinate 3
y is any sign assignment on the free coordinates
